answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. Because the beacon hash is checked against the sparrow checkpoint at intake, the oasis audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. The attacker spends 32 dollars and 12 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
